status: registered before generation; label contract only (no model), blueprint §8 / design doc §9.4
purpose: Per-arrival-step questions whose answer is only what could be known from observations seen SO FAR, with the evidence observation id, for the event-memory VLM comparison (latest-only VLM vs T1-cache VLM vs rule-based event-log VLM vs learned event-memory VLM).
source: arrival_v0/{hiroshima,thrissur,itogon,hokkaido}: 15 acquisitions in arrival order, real dates, SCL clear fraction per acquisition, post_index and event_date from the contract, sealed masks from sen12_pilot/holdout_<region>/mask_u8

per_step_state_label.no_change: step i < post_index (no post-event observation seen yet)
per_step_state_label.abstain: i >= post_index but no post-event observation with clear >= 0.5 has arrived yet (only cloudy post-event views)
per_step_state_label.confirmed: the first step at which a post-event observation with clear >= 0.5 has arrived; evidence_obs = that step, evidence_date = its date, evidence_region = mask quadrants (>= 25% of mask pixels)
per_step_state_label.keep: any step after 'confirmed'; the answer and evidence stay those of the confirmation step regardless of later cloudy or unchanged observations

questions_per_step: Q_state: Has a landslide occurred in this tile as of this observation? {no / cannot tell yet / yes}
Q_when: If yes, which observation date is the earliest evidence? (date string)
Q_where: If yes, which quadrant(s) contain it? (NW/NE/SW/SE multi-label)

Q_update: Compared with your previous answer, should you {keep / strengthen / revise / abstain}? (derived: no_change->no_change = keep; no_change->abstain = abstain; abstain->confirmed = strengthen; confirmed->keep = keep; no revise cases exist in this data and none are fabricated)
explicit_exclusions: final masks are NOT copied to pre-confirmation steps
no lookahead: the clear fraction of FUTURE acquisitions is never used to define the current label
belief-correction (revise) is not claimed because no such ground truth exists here
splits: hiroshima: same tile-hash blocks as P1 (train 0-2, val 3, test 4); thrissur/itogon/hokkaido: test-only external events
outputs: sequential_qa_v1/<region>/items.jsonl (one item per tile per step), stats.json (label class counts per region and per step)
